description:
This is a Pre-Solicitation notice for Service for Hofmann Balance Machine Modernization.  

FOB destination is Tinker AFB OK.

No quotes can be accepted until the solicitation has been posted.

Please make sure all provisions and clauses are appropriately filled in (where applicable), when submitting a quote. Please send in the actual solicitation (SF1449) completed along with any other documentation to support your company’s quote. Please make sure information stated is readable and legible. This is a Firm Fixed Price procurement, so please state the price on your quote as all inclusive of everything.   ( i.e. shipping, taxes, fees, etc.)
